notes: 'Automatic' (how many videos are worked on at once) now settles. When one more video at the same time did not make the work faster, it used to try again every two and a half minutes, for as long as the task ran. In the Subject Tracker run over 3,185 videos the graphics card was the limit, so it added a video and took it back for hours, and the two lines it wrote each time pushed everything else out of the task's log. Now it waits twice as long after every try that did not help (up to half an hour), and its line says when the next try is. When the PC gets clearly quieter in between, it tries right away. Applies to every page with 'Automatic'; a task that is already running keeps the old behaviour until Breezy is updated.

Measured in that run (new order, Automatic): finding subjects went at about 18 times real time, against 14.8 times in the run before it with one video at a time, and 179 results were there after 6 hours instead of none.
